scenarios.name: Open sketch-curve context menus during a 3D sketch

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is editing a 3D sketch with no other command or modal dialog active
its straight segment is visible and exposed
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Create 3D Line", "Bend", "Three Point Arc", "Helical Curve", "General Dimension", and "Finish 3D Sketch"
a standard context menu includes "Repeat Construction", "Edit 3D Sketch", "Properties...", "Measure", and "Export Object"
